detail: A seeded pixel sky with subtle star glow and a meteor trail

illustration.alt: Seeded 32-bit sequence branches into a text star field and a color canvas. The canvas layers diagonal haze, separated stars, small halos and one meteor trail.
illustration.caption: A 32-bit seed drives two repeatable views: a 38 by 12 terminal grid and a 64 by 40 pixel canvas with faint haze, star halos, and a static meteor trail.

title: Constellation Generator
